candidates.title: transversal matroid的成本保留Chernoff舍入
candidates.problem: 对每个显式transversal matroid M、每个有理fractional basis x、单有理cost c、k个[0,1]系数行a_r，随机多项式输出basis B；每个输出c(B)<=c*x，常数概率所有行同时满足|a_r(B)-a_r*x|<=O(log(2k)+sqrt((a_r*x)log(2k)))。不要求marginal preservation。
candidates.input_domain: 显式二部图给transversal表示；有理数二进制输入；任意k；一个cost；arbitrary row supports

target.error: Chernoff scale centered at original a_r*x

mother.title: Cost Preserving Dependent Rounding for Allocation Problems
mother.location: Theorem2; Section4 last two paragraphs explicitly ask matroid bases and suggest strongly base-orderable matroids

candidates.core_mechanism: dyadic TreeMerge; complementary labels; choose lower-cost whole level while preserving concentration
candidates.paper_fact: 母文在bipartite degree-preserving assignment及star-supported rows给成本保留集中舍入；matroid版本被明确提出。
candidates.new_idea: 从显式transversal表示实现strong base-ordering，令pairwise independent complementary merge支持arbitrary rows。

nearest.location: Theorem2 partition hard constraints and block-TU extension

candidates.feasibility_basis: SBO bijection admits independent swaps of element pairs; one-merge variance <= mean/2. Explicit representation avoids unimplemented abstract oracle.
candidates.dangerous_obstacle: 2026 face-preserving framework very likely directly implies the desired result for all matroids via a self-consistent error body. This is no longer recommended as an independent topic; technical and distribution-contract checks remain.
candidates.value_strategy: 工具型看可迁移硬预算优化；若为SOSA26直接推论则淘汰；不凭作者open一句话认定仍未解。
candidates.first_proof_obligation: Audit COST_CHERNOFF_COROLLARY_CHECK.md: minimize cost over P(M) intersect x-R; new means<=mu+r; choose K so ordinary face-preserving SwapRounding error<=r; SOSA26 local cost proof gives cost<=c*x and total error2r. Check face preservation, rational radii and exact original open distribution contract.
candidates.toy_model: rank3 transversal on6 elements,17 bases,136 pairs; exact8-outcome merge; K4 non-SBO boundary
candidates.falsifiable_test: Find pair without polynomially constructible strong bijection or cost-selected merge violating intended per-level concentration; do not require unchanged marginals.

facts: raw row mean3/2 becomes1 after cost selection

mother.title: Cost Preserving Dependent Rounding for Allocation Problems

candidates.core_mechanism: big/small economical LP + cost-preserving rounding + small-resource rounding
candidates.paper_fact: 真预算O(log n)；全常数改进公开提出。
candidates.new_idea: 用仅两值保留big/small难点但尝试使small重用常数。

nearest.location: STOC26 Theorem1.8 is unrelated-valuations n^epsilon polylog bicriteria, including budget violation

candidates.feasibility_basis: Only one small value may permit cardinality-cover or min-cost b-matching substructure.
candidates.dangerous_obstacle: Selecting which players obtain big resources is coupled through shared small resources; constant overlap with exact cost is unproved.
candidates.value_strategy: 公开问题切片应真正减少log n且预算严格；bicriteria不算推进本合同。
candidates.first_proof_obligation: Round economical LP with cost nonincrease and each small resource reused at most an absolute constant, or expose a two-value obstruction.
candidates.toy_model: two players, one big resource and up to6 unit resources, costs in{0,1,2}
candidates.falsifiable_test: Enumerate exact budget/value Pareto frontier and LP overlap; no two-budget extension without loss.

candidates.title: 两种容量的瓶颈多背包2/3近似
candidates.problem: 每固定epsilon>0，对所有公共正item weights、非负profits、capacities in{B1,B2}的BMKP输入，输出互不交部分分配，所有bin容量严格满足，min profit>=(2/3-epsilon)OPT。两种容量的bin数量任意、capacity ratio不受限。
candidates.input_domain: binary rational weights/profits/capacities; two distinct capacity values; items may be unused; all bins must attain the value guarantee

target.complexity: for each fixed epsilon, polynomial input-bit time; n^f(1/epsilon) acceptable

mother.title: Near-Tight Approximation Algorithms for Bottleneck Multiple Knapsack Problems
mother.location: Section7 final paragraph explicitly asks constant number of capacities; Lemma8/13/18 and Appendix A.1/A.2 give same-capacity structure

candidates.core_mechanism: capacity-specific heavy-item profiles, slack, expensive critical items, short exact-fit pairs, cheap rounding
candidates.paper_fact: identical capacities2/3-epsilon; arbitrary capacities1/2-epsilon and >1/2 hardness; hardness construction has potentially Theta(n) capacity values.
candidates.new_idea: Globally compute joint capacity-specific rounded labels; choose heaviest critical items by total joint-type demand across both capacities. Restore short bins by nested-eligibility fixed-cardinality matching. Use independent discard-allowed4pmax rounding rather than importing an ambiguous full-cover lemma.

nearest.location: Section6 hardness B_j=t-u_j uses many capacities, not two; Section7 explicitly leaves constant types open

candidates.feasibility_basis: Joint-type exchange preserves each long-bin rounded load and rounded profit, while replacing a heavier short item by a lighter one; short<=2 bounds profit loss. Only one nested quota is needed with two capacities.
candidates.dangerous_obstacle: Mother Lemma8 preprocessing and hidden epsilon rescaling must be made explicit. Local structure is an existence witness, not an algorithmically known partition. All-cheap long bins must remain distinct from short bins.
candidates.value_strategy: 分类型看容量类型数这一自然轴，推进2026明确问题；2/3界在同容量已紧，若保两capacity便有清晰边界。
candidates.first_proof_obligation: Given globally computable joint labels/profiles and type/configuration counts, recover disjoint canonical critical original items while preserving per-bin rounded slack; GA-03-L1 contains a full short proof, independently attacked. Complete careful preprocessing-to-gap-oracle chain remains unreviewed.
candidates.toy_model: two long bins, one short bin,8 expensive candidates; fixed joint labels; six-item unit-profit pair case
candidates.falsifiable_test: Independent capacity-wise heaviest selection repeats an item on a2x2 incidence matrix; arbitrary uncolored matching can starve small capacity. Joint exchanges and quota matching are separately audited.

audit.theorem_status: unreviewed algorithm candidate; no novelty certification

candidates.title: weighted laminar matroid的常数prefix误差
candidates.problem: 对每个height2 laminar matroid、任意element order、nonnegative weights、fractional basis x、single cost c，polytime找basis B，cost<=c*x，所有prefix weighted discrepancy<=C*wmax，C绝对常数。
candidates.input_domain: explicit laminar constraints, arbitrary order, arbitrary rational weights, one exact cost
candidates.core_mechanism: localized exchanges, partial coloring, face-preserving cost reduction
candidates.paper_fact: general O(log n); binary C=1; uniform weighted Theorem16 body is cost-free; constant conjecture remains general.
candidates.new_idea: Try laminar depth structure rather than arbitrary matroids, seeking truly constant prefix error.
candidates.feasibility_basis: Laminar base constraints have structured exchanges.
candidates.dangerous_obstacle: Even partition subtype contains a weighted prefix discrepancy core; cactus graphic is merely partition and not a new class.
candidates.value_strategy: 分类扩展须超越consecutive disjoint blocks/bounded active width的直接求和，不可只改名。
candidates.first_proof_obligation: Prove a cross-subtree exchange charging rule whose prefix error does not grow with the number of active blocks.
candidates.toy_model: two laminar levels with interleaved ordered blocks and two positive weights
candidates.falsifiable_test: Enumerate bases and Fraction prefix errors; reject C=1 because recent weighted carpool counterexamples already refute it more generally.
